title: American Standard Version
creator: American Revision Committee
edition: American Standard Version (1901) (eBible.org eng-asv USFM, source files dated 2026-10-30)

evidence.quote: The American Standard Version of the Holy Bible is in the Public Domain. Copy freely.

modifications: Converted from USFM to plain text, one entry per verse. Strong's numbers, footnotes and the italic markup for supplied words are removed; the supplied words themselves are kept. The acrostic letters of Psalm 119 are kept as headings. Verses the ASV leaves to footnotes, such as Romans 16:24, are marked as not in this translation. The note printed after Habakkuk 3:19 is omitted.
